# @three-ws/alibaba-cloud-mcp

> MCP server for Alibaba Cloud DashScope by three.ws — Qwen chat, embeddings, and model discovery using your own Alibaba Cloud API key.

@three-ws/alibaba-cloud-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/alibaba-cloud-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/alibaba-cloud-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/alibaba-cloud-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/alibaba-cloud-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/alibaba-cloud-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
